newsitem.title: UK: Northern Electric appoints new directors.
newsitem.headline: Northern Electric appoints new directors.

text.p: Northern Electric Plc made its first change in board structure after its takeover by CE Electric of the U.S. by bringing in eight new directors.
David Sokol, chairman and chief executive officer of CalEnergy Company, CE Energy's parent is among the new directors.
Northern Electric said one of its directors, John Grieves, who has been on the board since October 1, 1996, has resigned as board member.
Another director Stuart Errington had earlier expressed his intention to reture as board member and did so at the end of December.
